verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֕א אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֹמֵ֑ר ק֚וּם רִ֣יב אֶת־ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְתִשְׁמַ֥עְנָה הַגְּבָע֖וֹת קוֹלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- nā ’êṯ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ō·mêr qūm rîḇ ’eṯ- he·hā·rîm wə·ṯiš·ma‘·nāh hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ qō·w·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Hear now what the LORD says Arise plead your case before the mountains and let the hills hear your voice
verses.literalPt: OUVI agora o que diz o SENHOR: Levanta-te, contende com os montes, e ouçam os outeiros a tua voz.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ הָרִים֙ אֶת־ רִ֣יב יְהוָ֔ה וְהָאֵתָנִ֖ים מֹ֣סְדֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽיהוָה֙ עִם־ עַמּ֔וֹ וְעִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְוַכָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū hā·rîm ’eṯ- rîḇ Yah·weh wə·hā·’ê·ṯā·nîm mō·sə·ḏê ’ā·reṣ kî rîḇ Yah·weh ‘im- ‘am·mōw wə·‘im- yiś·rā·’êl yiṯ·wak·kāḥ
verses.literal: Hear O mountains the LORD’s indictment you enduring foundations of the earth For the LORD has a case against His people and He will argue it against Israel
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, montes, a demanda do SENHOR, e vós, fortes fundamentos da terra; porque o SENHOR tem uma demanda com o seu povo, e com Israel entrará em juízo.

verses.original: עַמִּ֛י מֶה־ עָשִׂ֥יתִי לְךָ֖ וּמָ֣ה הֶלְאֵתִ֑יךָ עֲנֵ֥ה בִּֽי׃
verses.literal: My people what have I done to you Testify against Me how I have wearied you
verses.literalPt: Ó povo meu; que te tenho feito? E com que te enfadei? Testifica contra mim.

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֶעֱלִתִ֙יךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִ֖ים פְּדִיתִ֑יךָ וָאֶשְׁלַ֣ח לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּמִרְיָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî he·‘ĕ·li·ṯî·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ū·mib·bêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm pə·ḏî·ṯî·ḵā wā·’eš·laḥ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’eṯ- mō·šeh ’a·hă·rōn ū·mir·yām
verses.literal: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery I sent Moses before you as well as Aaron and Miriam
verses.literalPt: Pois te fiz subir da terra do Egito, e da casa da servidão te remi; e enviei adiante de ti a Moisés, Arão e Miriã.

verses.original: עַמִּ֗י זְכָר־ נָא֙ מַה־ יָּעַ֗ץ בָּלָק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וּמֶה־ עָנָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ בְּע֑וֹר מִן־ הַשִּׁטִּים֙ עַד־ הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל לְמַ֕עַן דַּ֖עַת צִדְק֥וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mî zə·ḵār- nā mah- yā·‘aṣ bā·lāq me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ ū·meh- ‘ā·nāh ’ō·ṯōw bil·‘ām ben- bə·‘ō·wr min- haš·šiṭ·ṭîm ‘aḏ- hag·gil·gāl lə·ma·‘an da·‘aṯ ṣiḏ·qō·wṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: My people remember . . . what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Povo meu, lembra-te agora do que consultou Balaque, rei de Moabe, e o que lhe respondeu Balaão, filho de Beor, e do que aconteceu desde Sitim até Gilgal, para que conheças as justiças do SENHOR.

verses.original: בַּמָּה֙ אֲקַדֵּ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אִכַּ֖ף לֵאלֹהֵ֣י מָר֑וֹם הַאֲקַדְּמֶ֣נּוּ בְעוֹל֔וֹת בַּעֲגָלִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bam·māh ’ă·qad·dêm Yah·weh ’ik·kap̄ lê·lō·hê mā·rō·wm ha·’ă·qad·də·men·nū ḇə·‘ō·w·lō·wṯ ba·‘ă·ḡā·lîm bə·nê šā·nāh
verses.literal: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high Should I come to Him with burnt offerings with year-old . . . calves
verses.literalPt: Com que me apresentarei ao SENHOR, e me inclinarei diante do Deus altíssimo? Apresentar-me-ei diante dele com holocaustos, com bezerros de um ano?

verses.original: הֲיִרְצֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י אֵילִ֔ים בְּרִֽבְב֖וֹת נַֽחֲלֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶן הַאֶתֵּ֤ן בְּכוֹרִי֙ פִּשְׁעִ֔י פְּרִ֥י בִטְנִ֖י חַטַּ֥את נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yir·ṣeh Yah·weh bə·’al·p̄ê ’ê·lîm bə·riḇ·ḇō·wṯ na·ḥă·lê- šā·men ha·’et·tên bə·ḵō·w·rî piš·‘î pə·rî ḇiṭ·nî ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams with ten thousand rivers of oil Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul
verses.literalPt: Agradar-se-á o SENHOR de milhares de carneiros, ou de dez mil ribeiros de azeite? Darei o meu primogênito pela minha transgressão, o fruto do meu ventre pelo pecado da minha alma?

verses.original: הִגִּ֥יד לְךָ֛ אָדָ֖ם מַה־ טּ֑וֹב וּמָֽה־ יְהוָ֞ה דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ מִמְּךָ֗ כִּ֣י אִם־ עֲשׂ֤וֹת מִשְׁפָּט֙ וְאַ֣הֲבַת חֶ֔סֶד וְהַצְנֵ֥עַ לֶ֖כֶת עִם־ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hig·gîḏ lə·ḵā ’ā·ḏām mah- ṭō·wḇ ū·māh- Yah·weh dō·w·rêš mim·mə·ḵā kî ’im- ‘ă·śō·wṯ miš·pāṭ wə·’a·hă·ḇaṯ ḥe·seḏ wə·haṣ·nê·a‘ le·ḵeṯ ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: He has shown you O man what is good And what does the LORD require of you . . . but to act justly to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God
verses.literalPt: Ele te declarou, ó homem, o que é bom; e que é o que o SENHOR pede de ti, senão que pratiques a justiça, e ames a benignidade, e andes humildemente com o teu Deus?

verses.original: ק֤וֹל יְהוָה֙ לָעִ֣יר יִקְרָ֔א וְתוּשִׁיָּ֖ה יִרְאֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ שִׁמְע֥וּ מַטֶּ֖ה וּמִ֥י יְעָדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl Yah·weh lā·‘îr yiq·rā wə·ṯū·šî·yāh yir·’eh šə·me·ḵā šim·‘ū maṭ·ṭeh ū·mî yə·‘ā·ḏāh
verses.literal: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city and it is sound wisdom to fear Your name Heed the rod and the One who ordained it
verses.literalPt: A voz do SENHOR clama à cidade e o que é sábio verá o teu nome. Ouvi a vara, e quem a ordenou.

verses.original: ע֗וֹד הַאִשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע אֹצְר֖וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וְאֵיפַ֥ת רָז֖וֹן זְעוּמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ ha·’iš bêṯ rā·šā‘ ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ re·ša‘ wə·’ê·p̄aṯ rā·zō·wn zə·‘ū·māh
verses.literal: Can I forget any longer . . . O house of the wicked the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah which is accursed
verses.literalPt: Ainda há na casa do ímpio tesouros da impiedade, e medida escassa, que é detestável?

verses.original: הַאֶזְכֶּ֖ה בְּמֹ֣אזְנֵי רֶ֑שַׁע וּבְכִ֖יס אַבְנֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.literal: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights
verses.literalPt: Seria eu limpo com balanças falsas, e com uma bolsa de pesos enganosos?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׁירֶ֙יהָ֙ מָלְא֣וּ חָמָ֔ס וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ דִּבְּרוּ־ שָׁ֑קֶר וּלְשׁוֹנָ֖ם רְמִיָּ֥ה בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ‘ă·šî·re·hā mā·lə·’ū ḥā·mās wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā dib·bə·rū- šā·qer ū·lə·šō·w·nām rə·mî·yāh bə·p̄î·hem
verses.literal: For the wealthy of the city are full of violence and its residents speak lies their tongues are deceitful in their mouths
verses.literalPt: Porque os seus ricos estão cheios de violência, e os seus habitantes falam mentiras e a sua língua é enganosa na sua boca.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִ֖י הֶחֱלֵ֣יתִי הַכּוֹתֶ֑ךָ הַשְׁמֵ֖ם עַל־ חַטֹּאתֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: Therefore I am striking you severely to ruin you because of your sins
verses.literalPt: Assim eu também te enfraquecerei, ferindo-te e assolando-te por causa dos teus pecados.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה תֹאכַל֙ וְלֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּ֔ע וְיֶשְׁחֲךָ֖ בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְתַסֵּג֙ וְלֹ֣א תַפְלִ֔יט וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּפַלֵּ֖ט לַחֶ֥רֶב אֶתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ṯō·ḵal wə·lō ṯiś·bā‘ wə·yeš·ḥă·ḵā bə·qir·be·ḵā wə·ṯas·sêḡ wə·lō ṯap̄·lîṭ wa·’ă·šer tə·p̄al·lêṭ la·ḥe·reḇ ’et·tên
verses.literal: You will eat but not be satisfied and your hunger will remain with you What you acquire you will not preserve and what you save I will give to the sword
verses.literalPt: Tu comerás, mas não te fartarás e a tua humilhação estará no meio de ti; removerás os teus bens mas não livrarás; e aquilo que livrares, eu o entregarei à espada.

verses.original: אַתָּ֥ה תִזְרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א תִקְצ֑וֹר אַתָּ֤ה תִדְרֹֽךְ־ זַ֙יִת֙ וְלֹא־ תָס֣וּךְ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁתֶּה־ יָּֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ṯiz·ra‘ wə·lō ṯiq·ṣō·wr ’at·tāh ṯiḏ·rōḵ- za·yiṯ wə·lō- ṯā·sūḵ še·men wə·ṯî·rō·wōš wə·lō ṯiš·teh- yā·yin
verses.literal: You will sow but not reap you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil you will tread grapes but not drink the wine
verses.literalPt: Tu semearás, mas não segarás; pisarás a azeitona, mas não te ungirás com azeite; e pisarás o mosto, mas não beberás vinho.

verses.original: וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּ֞ר חֻקּ֣וֹת עָמְרִ֗י וְכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה בֵית־ אַחְאָ֔ב וַתֵּלְכ֖וּ בְּמֹֽעֲצוֹתָ֑ם לְמַעַן֩ תִּתִּ֨י אֹתְךָ֜ לְשַׁמָּ֗ה וְיֹשְׁבֶ֙יהָ֙ לִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖י תִּשָּֽׂאוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·yiš·tam·mêr ḥuq·qō·wṯ ‘ā·mə·rî wə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh ḇêṯ- ’aḥ·’āḇ wat·tê·lə·ḵū bə·mō·‘ă·ṣō·w·ṯām lə·ma·‘an tit·tî ’ō·ṯə·ḵā lə·šam·māh wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā liš·rê·qāh wə·ḥer·paṯ ‘am·mî tiś·śā·’ū
verses.literal: You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house you have followed their counsel Therefore I will make you a desolation and your inhabitants an object of contempt you will bear the scorn of the nations
verses.literalPt: Porque se observam os estatutos de Onri, e toda a obra da casa de Acabe, e andais nos conselhos deles; para que eu te faça uma desolação, e dos seus habitantes um assobio; assim trareis sobre vós o opróbrio do meu povo.
